title: Wick Renormalized Parabolic Stochastic Quantization Equations on Rough Metric Measure Spaces
summary: On metric measure spaces with sub-Gaussian heat kernel behavior in small time, we obtain a sufficient condition to solve Wick renormalized stochastic quantization equations with polynomial interaction. Given the power of the nonlinearity, the local solution condition depends on the Hausdorff dimension $d_h$, the walk dimension $d_w$, and the maximal spatial Hölder regularity of the heat kernel $Θ$.
